mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during inflation spikes above 2%, or CPIAUCSL does not revert downward within 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 monthly increases, signaling labor market strength that supports S&P 500 positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite sustained PAYEMS growth above 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 triggers a contrarian equity positioning as weak manufacturing demand is expected to prompt rate cuts and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when INDPRO remains persistently below 100 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in consumer demand measured by HOUST (> -10% month-over-month) combined with low industrial activity (INDPRO < 90) creates supply-side stress, pushing S&P 500 60-day forward returns negative.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both HOUST and INDPRO recover to > -5% and > 95, respectively.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for three consecutive months indicates tighter labor market policy expectations, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or flat when UNRATE remains above 6.5 for the subsequent 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment reflected in UNRATE below 4.5% signals labor market strength, which elevates risk sentiment and drives positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when UNRATE remains above 4.5 for the next 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (industrial activity) below 400M and 900, respectively, indicates weak demand, which predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both indicators recover to > 450M and > 950 within 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of falling industrial production (INDPRO < 100 for 4 consecutive months) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0) signals supply-side stagnation, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not negative (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 100 and UNRATE falls below 5.5 within the same window.
